name: com.hoppaplay.adsrecording
description: Records gameplay touch interactions on device and writes them as a timestamped JSON log, which the Hoppa ad video editor replays to reconstruct the player's finger over a screen recording. Hides the game UI during capture, marks the start and end of a take with a sync flash so the editor can align the log to the video, and shares the result straight off the device. Requires Unity-DevKit.

samples.description: Two on-screen buttons that start a take and share the JSON.
